text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hanshin Racecourse was filled with
an unusual buzz after the Asahi Hai FS concluded.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wasn't that Fuji Kiseki girl's running insane?
Isn't she the top of our generation?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, without a doubt, she's gonna be the star of next year's Classic class!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: I really hope she achieves Triple Crown Umamusume status~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing changing, while checking the location
of the lodging we had booked—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki-san,
that was a magnificent race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A reporter rushes over, looking thoroughly excited.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Expectations are running extremely high! Excuse me, but could we get a word from you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I'm grateful for their enthusiasm, but... sudden interviews can become quite stressful.
choice_data_list: I'm sorry, but you'll need to go through the academy first—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, Trainer.
To tell the truth, there was something I wanted to tell everyone too."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"If thou hast received unconditional love, if thy heart hath
hatched from its shell, then with single-minded devotion, become the light."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "...Those are words someone said to me a long time ago. During today's race, they suddenly came back to me."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I could hear everyone's voices cheering me on, so
I was able to focus single-mindedly, purely on victory."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“—Thank you for the love.
Please look forward to me winning the Classic Triple Crown!”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Is something like this alright?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
...!
Thank you very much, it's perfect!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Wonderful!
I'll be looking forward to a fantastic article.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And also... bad timing can happen, so please go through the academy before approaching me in the future.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Well then, take care!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pierced by Fuji Kiseki's tender gaze...
the reporter flushed bright red and ran off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next morning. On the way back to the academy—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh, it's already an article...!?
That writer works fast.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The online article featured a passionate write-up accompanied by beautiful photos of Fuji Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Umm—"Fuji Kiseki, the rising star who captivated the crowd with an incredible run at the Asahi Hai FS. Expressing gratitude to the fans, heading towards the next goal—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Next year's star has already been decided"—Ahaha,
they wrapped it up so coolly. I'm thrilled!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Looks like most of the comments on the article
are full of anticipation too. What a relief!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer.
What should we do for the next race?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good!
Actually, I was just thinking of suggesting the same thing.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"If possible, it'd be good to run 2,000 meters on
a big stage to prepare for the Satsuki Sho."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At the Asahi Hai FS, Fuji Kiseki was able to fully showcase her true strength to the world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Aiming to reach even higher in our next target race, the Yayoi Sho, we renewed our determination.
